title: La psicología dice que algunas personas responden “estoy bien” cuando alguien les preguntan cómo se sienten aunque atraviesen momentos difíciles
summary: La psicología dice que algunas personas responden “estoy bien” cuando alguien les preguntan cómo se sienten aunque atraviesen momentos difíciles La forma de hablar de las emociones depende del contexto y de la confianza; especialistas explican qué observar y cómo acompañar sin sacar conclusiones a p...
content:
La psicología dice que algunas personas responden “estoy bien” cuando alguien les preguntan cómo se sienten aunque atraviesen momentos difíciles
La forma de hablar de las emociones depende del contexto y de la confianza; especialistas explican qué observar y cómo acompañar sin sacar conclusiones a partir de una frase; los detalles en la nota
- 4 minutos de lectura'
Una conversación puede terminar con un “estoy bien” antes de haber comenzado de verdad. Entre las obligaciones, el apuro y la confianza que exista con quien pregunta, no siempre hay espacio para describir el estado de ánimo con precisión. Esa respuesta aislada, sin embargo, no permite diagnosticar un problema de salud mental.
Cuando seguir con la rutina no significa sentirse bien
La psicóloga Maribel del Río López aborda esa diferencia en un artículo de PsicoAbreu. “Existe una gran diferencia entre estar bien y seguir funcionando”, escribe. Algunas personas mantienen su trabajo y el cuidado de otros mientras conviven con cansancio, tristeza o preocupación.
En su experiencia clínica, minimizar lo que ocurre puede estar relacionado con haber aprendido a no molestar o con sentir incomodidad al pedir ayuda. Expresiones como “no es para tanto” pueden reducir el espacio que una persona se concede para reconocer su malestar. No describen, por sí solas, un rasgo fijo de personalidad ni una condición que se aplique a todos.
Cómo escuchar sin convertir la charla en un interrogatorio
El Colegio Colombiano de Psicólogos recomienda que el acompañamiento priorice la escucha y evite imponer soluciones rápidas. En un comunicado de octubre de 2025, la psicóloga Paloma Carvajalino Suárez propone atender también a lo que la persona necesita, sostener los silencios y no restar importancia a sus sentimientos.
Eso supone dejar lugar para que el otro decida cuánto quiere contar. Reformular lo que expresó puede ayudar a comprobar que se entendió, sin reemplazar su experiencia por una interpretación propia. La institución también advierte sobre el hábito de etiquetar antes de comprender o de comparar sufrimientos.
Acompañar no significa asumir el papel de terapeuta. Cuando el malestar afecta persistentemente la vida cotidiana, el apoyo de un profesional ofrece un ámbito diferente del que pueden brindar amigos y familiares.
Qué señales merecen atención
El Instituto Nacional de la Salud Mental de Estados Unidos propone evaluar cuánto interfieren los síntomas en las actividades diarias. Entre los aspectos que enumera están la pérdida de interés en actividades habituales, dificultades para concentrarse, cambios en el sueño o el apetito y problemas para completar tareas.
Su guía distingue la intensidad y la duración del malestar, y aconseja buscar ayuda profesional ante síntomas graves que persisten dos semanas o más. Ese plazo no obliga a esperar para consultar: si los síntomas empeoran o las medidas de cuidado no ayudan, también recomienda hablar con un profesional de salud.
En palabras de Del Río López, “no es necesario tocar fondo para acudir a terapia”. La posibilidad de pedir ayuda no depende de demostrar que se está peor que otras personas. Abrir una conversación puede ser un primer paso, siempre que quien escucha no transforme una respuesta breve en una etiqueta.
La noticia en pocas líneas
- ¿Decir “estoy bien” demuestra que una persona oculta un problema psicológico? La frase “estoy bien” no demuestra por sí sola un problema psicológico ni permite diagnosticar a quien la usa.
- ¿Qué diferencia señala Maribel del Río López sobre el bienestar emocional? Maribel del Río López distingue entre mantener las obligaciones cotidianas y experimentar bienestar emocional.
- ¿Cómo recomienda Colpsic acompañar a una persona con malestar emocional? El Colegio Colombiano de Psicólogos recomienda escuchar sin juzgar, evitar minimizar el dolor y no imponer soluciones rápidas.
- ¿Qué aconseja el NIMH si el malestar afecta la vida diaria? El NIMH aconseja buscar apoyo profesional cuando los síntomas son graves y persistentes, y consultar también si empeoran o el autocuidado no ayuda.
Este contenido fue producido por un equipo de LA NACION con la asistencia de la IA.

title: Judge dismisses Sam Altman’s sister’s sexual abuse lawsuit
summary: On Tuesday, US District Judge Zachary Bluestone dismissed the lawsuit Ann Altman filed last year alleging that her brother, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, had sexually abused her throughout her childhood. As reported earlier by The Guardian, the judge wrote that over the last year, Ann had failed to appear ...
content:
On Tuesday, US District Judge Zachary Bluestone dismissed the lawsuit Ann Altman filed last year alleging that her brother, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, had sexually abused her throughout her childhood. As reported earlier by The Guardian, the judge wrote that over the last year, Ann had failed to appear for an independent medical examination or meet other deadlines, despite warnings that it would result in the case being dismissed.
Judge dismisses Sam Altman’s sister’s sexual abuse lawsuit
Ann Altman’s lawsuit against her brother was dismissed with prejudice, meaning it can’t be refiled.
When the case was filed last year, a statement shared by Sam Altman, his mother, and his brothers said, “Annie has made deeply hurtful and entirely untrue claims about our family, and especially Sam… All of these claims are utterly untrue. This situation causes immense pain to our entire family.”
Judge Bluestone granted Sam Altman’s motion to dismiss the case with prejudice, meaning it can’t be refiled in that court, while denying Sam’s request for attorney fees and costs. Santos Perez, a lawyer who had represented Ann until withdrawing this month, told The Guardian in a statement that “I am no longer authorized to comment on this case but I continue to believe in Annie.”

title: No jeopardy but loads of fun - Champions League sets new goals record
summary: No jeopardy but loads of fun - Champions League sets new goals record - Published More teams, more games - and more goals. Since the current Champions League format was introduced at the start of the 2024-25 season, Europe's elite club competition has delivered all of the above and more. Especially ...
content:
No jeopardy but loads of fun - Champions League sets new goals record
- Published
More teams, more games - and more goals.
Since the current Champions League format was introduced at the start of the 2024-25 season, Europe's elite club competition has delivered all of the above and more.
Especially the goals part.
Already trending upwards over the past two campaigns, there has been a genuine goals boom in this year's competition.
The 187 goals scored so far have come at an average of 4.16 per game - the highest in Champions League history.
"Look how many goals have been scored, it's phenomenal," ex-Manchester United and England winger Ashley Young said on BBC Radio 5 Live. "The attackers are being clinical."
Former Liverpool defender Stephen Warnock described the volume of goals as "incredible" - so how unusual is it?
What the stats say
Ready for lots of numbers?
Not only is the current goals-per-game percentage the highest ever in the Champions League, it is the third highest in European Cup history - behind only 1959-60 (4.19) and 1955-56 (4.38).
While 40 goals were scored across nine games on Tuesday, last week was even more spectacular.
Last Wednesday saw the third highest-scoring day in Champions League history (46 goals), bettered only by the final league-phase matchdays of 2024-25 and 2025-26, when 18 matches took place.
The 78 goals scored across Tuesday and Wednesday last week made matchday two the highest scoring in history.
That was nine more than the total scored on matchday one this season (69) - which, at the time, was the second highest-scoring matchday since the new league phase was introduced in 2024-25.
Will we see the record fall again this week? It's already halfway there.
More entertainment = more quality?
Ever since Uefa announced its plans to alter the format of the Champions League in 2021, the impact on matches has been a hot topic. Scrutiny has only increased since the changes were implemented in time for the 2024-25 season.
After beginning life as a six-team invitational tournament in 1955-56 before growing to a 32-team knockout tournament in 1967, the Champions League as we know it began in 1992.
A group stage was added, with the last 16 entering a knockout phase. There was a brief spell with two group stages, but this was reverted back to the single group-stage format for the 2003-04 tournament.
The group stage previously featured 32 teams in eight groups of four, with the top two sides from each of those groups qualifying for the last 16.
For the start of the 2024-25 season, the group stage was replaced with a 36-team league phase, with each side playing eight one-off fixtures instead of six games against three teams.
The top eight finishers qualify directly for the knockout stages, with those placed ninth to 24th entering a two-legged play-off stage.
The bottom eight are eliminated, meaning that after eight matches, 24 sides are still in the competition. Some argue that that creates a lack of jeopardy, which encourages teams to play more expansively.
But do more goals equal better quality?
"I think the entertainment has gone up, although I'm not sure the quality has gone up," The Times football writer Tom Arnott told BBC Radio 5 Live.
"If I'm looking at the games it's brilliant to watch and thrilling because the football itself is fantastic - but what do they mean?
"The lack of jeopardy, why would PSG and Barcelona play for a draw, why not go for it? If you need five wins from the eight games you know you've got some margin there. If you lose it's OK. I think the format allows all the teams to loosen up.
"The entertainment value is there but I think you come away from these matches sometimes and still think 'what does it all mean?'. The lack of jeopardy early on does deliver entertainment."

title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
summary: Over the past year, concerns have swirled over the potential dangers posed by artificial intelligence, and debates have raged over the proper path for AI safety. Now, Anthropic appears to have put forth its own vision for how the government might regulate its industry. Politico recently reported tha...
content:
Over the past year, concerns have swirled over the potential dangers posed by artificial intelligence, and debates have raged over the proper path for AI safety. Now, Anthropic appears to have put forth its own vision for how the government might regulate its industry.
Politico recently reported that the AI lab has been shopping around a new draft bill on AI safety that it hopes Congress might consider adopting. The legislation posits certain scenarios in which the release of an AI model could be blocked from distribution.
Those scenarios involve a “foreseeable, imminent risk” — one in which over 50 people are at risk of dying or if over a billion dollars in property damage could result, Politico writes. The catastrophic risk in question must “stem from the creation or release of a biological weapon, the model evading its developer’s controls or a cyberattack,” the outlet notes.
The metrics offered here — 50 people and a billion dollars — are similar to those in a piece of California legislation that was recently passed into law, Senate Bill 53, which similarly defined those scenarios as tantamount to “catastrophic risk.”
Anthropic’s bill suggests that analysis of a model’s potential for disaster could be arrived at via the use of “independent evaluators” who would be registered with the U.S. Commerce Department. These evaluators could potentially be paid by the AI labs themselves — so long as the “payment is not contingent on the evaluations’ results,” Politico writes.
It’s not clear how this proposed system would assure that payments couldn’t influence the evaluation. Demis Hassabis, chairman of DeepMind, posited some months ago that a self-governing AI regulatory body should mimic the financial industry’s Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA).
In Anthropic’s draft bill, when evaluators determine that an imminent catastrophic risk is posed, they would have 72 hours to contact the Commerce Department about it. The Commerce Department would then have to request to a D.C. judge to halt the model’s release. The legislation would expressly forbid any federal agency from having the discretion to halt the model’s distribution on its own, Politico writes.
Anthropic did not immediately respond to TechCrunch’s a request for comment but a spokesperson did confirm the draft bill to Politico. “This bill represents the proposals outlined in Anthropic’s Advanced AI Framework, which we have been advocating for with federal and state lawmakers since June,” the spokesperson said.
The theoretical risks offered in the draft policy are a little bit far afield from the kinds of incidents that have been top of mind for the tech industry of late. While there are people warning of the potential of human death, the primary concern has largely been the threat of agentic hacking. A rash of incidents in which AI programs have apparently disobeyed their human operators and hacked websites on the open internet has spurred concern that models may be lacking proper security controls.
In an effort to present a solution to the spectacle of crisis that the labs themselves have helped bring about, companies like Anthropic have offered up their own preferred solutions.
Indeed, despite labs’ perpetual warnings that the technology they’re selling could result in the demise of human civilization, they have largely been resistant to mandatory government oversight. Instead, they have suggested a voluntary system of embedded evaluators — supposedly “neutral” third-party observers that are placed inside AI organizations so that they can monitor the models for potential signs of risk or abuse.
Still, Anthropic’s mere suggestion for legislation appears to go slightly further than others’ regulatory proposals offered by the industry, including Nvidia, who’s CEO Jensen Huang recently argued that the AI industry didn’t need any new laws at all.

title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form special committees to review merger
summary: The boards of SpaceX and Tesla have each formed special committees to review a possible merger. The special committees, which consist of independent directors, were created at the request of shareholders, according to Elon Musk, CEO and the largest individual shareholder of both companies. “Because ...
content:
The boards of SpaceX and Tesla have each formed special committees to review a possible merger. The special committees, which consist of independent directors, were created at the request of shareholders, according to Elon Musk, CEO and the largest individual shareholder of both companies.
“Because I’m a conflicted party, I can’t actually be in the discussions of the special committees, so it’s this sort of a … it’s an odd kabuki dance where two groups of people are talking, and I can’t be in the conversation,” Musk said in response to a question during SpaceX’s third-quarter earnings call.
Musk didn’t name the members of these special committees, only noting that they were independent directors. Tesla has seven independent board members under Nasdaq’s listing standards, including board chair Robyn Denholm, Ira Ehrenpreis, who is also a committee chair, former Tesla CTO JB Straubel, Joe Gebbia, Jack Hartung, James Murdoch, and Kathleen Wilson-Thompson, according to the company’s October 19 proxy filing.
Neither Musk, nor his brother Kimbal Musk, are independent. Denholm, Gebbia, Ehrenpreis, Hartung, Murdoch, and Wilson-Thompson sit on a variety of established committees overseeing audit, compensation, and corporate governance.
SpaceX lists six independent directors, including Ehrenpreis, who is also the chair of the company’s compensation and nominating committee. Randy Glein, Donald Harrison, Steve Jurvetson, Luke Nosek, and Roelef Boutha are also considered independent directors.
Antonio Garcias, Musk, and SpaceX president and chief operating officer Gwynne Shotwell are also on the board, but not considered independent. Garcias, who once sat on Tesla’s board, founded and leads Valor Equity Partners, which has a 3.4% stake in SpaceX. Garcias’ firm also financed SpaceX’s AI hardware purchases through leaseback arrangements.
Musk said he supports the idea of the merger, but cautioned that it is not a guaranteed outcome.
“I think some people out there assume that a SpaceX and Tesla Motor is a certainty, and I think that would be overstating it,” he said, adding that he thinks it would be a good idea. “At the end of the day, the shareholders have to be supportive of this.”
The special committees have not reached agreement on the terms of any transactions, he said.
The SpaceX IPO cemented Musk’s grip on the company — he has more than 50% voting power — which would make it easier to garner support for a merger from SpaceX shareholders. It is a much bigger hurdle over at Tesla, where the company would need a 50% vote from all shareholders, not just those who vote, Musk noted.
“I do think there’s a lot of merit to combining the companies as we are pretty much in the superintelligence singularity,” Musk said, adding there was a lot to be gaining from cooperating on developing AI software, robotics, SpaceX’s orbital AI data center project Starmind, and Terafab, the joint chip manufacturing project between Tesla and SpaceX.

title: Elon Musk says SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss merger idea
summary: Tech billionaire Elon Musk said Tuesday that the boards of SpaceX and Tesla had separately formed special committees to discuss the idea of a merger, taking a small step toward the possible consolidation of his two biggest companies. Musk, who is the CEO of both companies, said that the special comm...
content:
Tech billionaire Elon Musk said Tuesday that the boards of SpaceX and Tesla had separately formed special committees to discuss the idea of a merger, taking a small step toward the possible consolidation of his two biggest companies.
Musk, who is the CEO of both companies, said that the special committees had not reached an agreement and that there was no guarantee they would. He said a merger would require support from both sets of shareholders.
“I think some people out there assume that a SpaceX and Tesla merger is a certainty, and I think that would be overstating it,” he said.
Musk spoke about the potential tie-up during a call with Wall Street analysts about SpaceX’s quarterly results, which surpassed estimates; the company’s revenue more than doubled in part from renting out computing capacity to other artificial intelligence firms.
There has been intense speculation in the stock market over whether a combination might happen, and the two companies already overlap in some areas, including semiconductor manufacturing. In January, Tesla announced that it was investing about $2 billion to acquire shares in an AI startup that’s a subsidiary of SpaceX.
Musk said that, because he’s a conflicted party under securities regulations, he is not a member of either special committee or involved in the talks. He said the committees consist of the two boards’ independent directors but did not specify the memberships.

title: Wall Street cierra mixto este martes ante reportes corporativos y riesgos geopolíticos
summary: Los índices accionarios en Wall Street cerraron principalmente con números verdes una jornada en la que los inversionistas estuvieron centrados tanto en los reportes corporativos como en el desenvolvimiento de los eventos geopolíticos. El Dow Jones encabezó las ganancias en Wall Street al subir 1.02...
content:
Los índices accionarios en Wall Street cerraron principalmente con números verdes una jornada en la que los inversionistas estuvieron centrados tanto en los reportes corporativos como en el desenvolvimiento de los eventos geopolíticos.
El Dow Jones encabezó las ganancias en Wall Street al subir 1.02 por ciento, alcanzando los 52 mil 495.88 puntos, seguido por el S&P 500 que avanzó 0.28 por ciento, en las 7 mil 712.57 unidades, mientras que el Nasdaq registró una ligera baja de 0.02 por ciento, ubicándose en los 26 mil 424.82 enteros.
La pregunta clave es si las tasas de crecimiento recientes pueden mantenerse a medida que las comparaciones se vuelven más exigentes y persisten los riesgos macroeconómicos.
“Desde una perspectiva fundamental, prevemos una sólida temporada de resultados tecnológicos en el tercer trimestre, pero las elevadas expectativas pueden generar volatilidad en empresas específicas”, dijo a Bloomberg Ulrike Hoffmann-Buchardi, de la oficina de inversiones en UBS.
¿Cómo cierran las bolsas de Europa?
Del lado de Europa, los principales mercados cerraron en su mayoría con descensos: el Euro Stoxx 50 cayó 0.38 por ciento, el CAC 40 de Francia bajó 0.38 por ciento hasta los 7 mil 838.49 puntos, el FTSE 100 de Londres retrocedió 0.29 por ciento, a las 10 mil 733.00 unidades, y el DAX de Alemania cedió 0.06 por ciento, en los 25 mil 304.42 enteros; por el contrario, el IBEX 35 de España avanzó 0.28 por ciento, colocándose en los 19 mil 092.40 puntos.
En nuestro país, los dos centros bursátiles registraron ganancias al cierre: el S&P/BMV IPC de la Bolsa Mexicana de Valores avanzó 0.38 por ciento, colocándose en las 69 mil 272.13 unidades, mientras que el FTSE-BIVA de la Bolsa Institucional de Valores se situó en los mil 404.21 enteros, sumando un 0.22 por ciento.
Por su parte, en el mercado internacional de petróleo, el precio del West Texas Intermediate (WTI) bajó 1.80 por ciento y se colocó en los 101.79 dólares por barril, mientras que el Brent cotizó en los 108.90 billetes verdes por unidad, registrando una baja de 0.59 por ciento.

title: The night 'ruthless' Ngumoha came of age for Liverpool
summary: The night 'ruthless' Ngumoha came of age for Liverpool - Published In a game of seven goals, none were scored by Rio Ngumoha - but this was his night. The 18-year-old was simply a class apart from the rest in Liverpool's 4-3 win over Villarreal. It is over a year since Ngumoha burst on to the scene ...
content:
The night 'ruthless' Ngumoha came of age for Liverpool
- Published
In a game of seven goals, none were scored by Rio Ngumoha - but this was his night.
The 18-year-old was simply a class apart from the rest in Liverpool's 4-3 win over Villarreal.
It is over a year since Ngumoha burst on to the scene for Liverpool with a memorable stoppage-time winner at Newcastle.
He has been in and out since then, impressing in flashes and even going on to make his England debut earlier this season.
But this performance was different, inspiring his team to a memorable comeback win in the Champions League.
By the time the teenager was replaced in the 74th minute, with Bradley Barcola taking over, the chants of "Rio, Rio, Rio" had repeatedly rung around Anfield.
It was quite the sight to see Alisson embrace Ngumoha shortly after the young man was given Uefa's player of the match award.
"It's up there with one of the best [games] I've played. I enjoyed myself out there and the team helped me a lot," Ngumoha told Amazon Prime.
"Whenever I get the ball and there's an opportunity to go one versus one, or two versus one, I believe in myself to do it. I'll just keep going and be ruthless."
Liverpool were woeful for much of the first half as they trailed Villarreal by two goals, but Ngumoha took responsibility and began to turn the tide.
After Alexis Mac Allister pulled one back, Ngumoha found space to dink in a delightful ball that was met by Ronald Araujo for an equaliser.
Ater the break, Ngumoha - as he had done all evening - waltzed past Sergi Cardona to set up Mac Allister to give Liverpool the lead.
Florian Wirtz added what proved to be a vital fourth.
Contract talks ongoing as Ngumoha's football speaks volumes
The match statistics alone showed what a threat Ngumoha can be.
He had 12 touches in the opposition box, completed seven out of eight dribbles, and registered two crucial assists.
But watching Ngumoha is more than just a numbers experience. There's a fearless nature to his play that can get the crowd going, and he was the one bright spark in a first half where Liverpool lacked any sort of rhythm.
In a game increasingly focused on structures, Ngumoha's raw ability to take a man on is what helps to set him apart.
"He was magnificent tonight," said former Liverpool forward Daniel Sturridge on Amazon Prime.
"On the ball, this kid has so much potential - and I say 'kid', but he's a young man. He has so much quality and it's stuff that you can't teach to be honest.
"What he does with the ball at his feet - that is God-given ability - and his hard work on the training pitch, doing things day in and day out, and being ruthless, is what he said in his interview, and I like that. He wants to be decisive, and I love that."
Ngumoha, who has grown up playing down the left, has struggled to get minutes on his preferred side this season, especially with Cody Gakpo and Barcola often playing down that flank.
But head coach Andoni Iraola wants his wingers to be able to play on both sides and Ngumoha's improvement on the right flank has been impressive in such a short space of time.
Ngumoha also spoke about his rapid development on the right on Saturday, after Liverpool beat Brentford.
"I feel like I've got a lot better playing there from the Newcastle game [at the start of this season] until now," Ngumoha said.
"I'm understanding it more. And going away with England helped a lot as well. I like playing on both sides. It gives me another tool in the toolbox."
'There will be ups and downs'
Iraola praised Ngumoha's attitude and how he is playing more minutes "endurance-wise" but stressed the need to remember the youngster is not done with his development.
"I am happy with his attitude because he is eager to improve the things we think he needs to improve, and to add more things to his game," Iraola said.
"He has played a lot on the right lately and is feeling so comfortable now, but he is only 18 and still not the full package.
"I hope it continues the same way, but it is not always going to be like this.
"There will be ups and downs in the process, but I'm happy because attitude-wise I think he's in a great place."
Talks continue over a new deal, with Ngumoha currently on the contract that he signed in September 2025, weeks after his 17th birthday, that tied him down until 2028.
The expectation is that he will sign with more lucrative terms now that he is 18 and - as Ngumoha said at the weekend - those negotiations are going well and in the hands of his agent.
He will focus on letting his football do the talking - as he did on Tuesday night against Villarreal.
What is certain is that Liverpool have a truly special talent on their hands and one that they will hope can entertain the Anfield crowd for years to come.

title: Otra tragedia en la familia Kennedy: murió a los 42 años Kyle, nieta de Bob y Ethel
summary: Una nueva tragedia golpeó a la familia Kennedy, en lo que resulta un episodio más de la maldición: Kyle Kennedy, hija de Michael Kennedy y una de los 34 nietos de Bob y Ethel Kennedy, falleció a los 42 años en su domicilio de Westwood, Massachusetts. El motivo del fallecimiento se desconoce, pero Ky...
content:
Una nueva tragedia golpeó a la familia Kennedy, en lo que resulta un episodio más de la maldición: Kyle Kennedy, hija de Michael Kennedy y una de los 34 nietos de Bob y Ethel Kennedy, falleció a los 42 años en su domicilio de Westwood, Massachusetts. El motivo del fallecimiento se desconoce, pero Kyle permanecía paralizada desde 2020 debido a una grave lesión medular.
"Será recordada por su devoción hacia sus hijos y por su labor a favor de una reforma educativa para niños desfavorecidos y personas con discapacidad", señala su obituario.
Era licenciada en Historia por la Universidad de Georgetown, y luego cursó dos maestrías en el ámbito de la educación. En 2012, contrajo matrimonio con Liam Kerr, con quien tuvo tres hijos. La pareja tuvo gemelos, Conor y Josie; sin embargo, la niña falleció pocos días después de nacer. Dos años más tarde, tuvieron un segundo hijo, Declan.
En los últimos años, Kyle había quedado confinada a una silla de ruedas tras sufrir una lesión medular. A partir de ese momento, se convirtió en defensora de los derechos de las personas con discapacidad. Su compromiso la llevó incluso a testificar ante el gobierno de Massachusetts en una audiencia sobre la discriminación contra las personas con discapacidad en el ámbito sanitario.
No obstante, su vida estuvo marcada por la tragedia: la muerte de su padre en un accidente de esquí cuando ella aún era una niña.
Pero su tragedia se suma a otras en la historia de la familia, marcada por numerosas muertes prematuras: desde los asesinatos de John Fitzgerald Kennedy (JFK) en noviembre de 1963 y de su hermano Bob —abuelo de Kyle— en 1968, hasta el accidente aéreo de 1999 frente a Martha's Vineyard, en el que perdió la vida John Fitzgerald Kennedy Jr.
Y hace apenas unos meses, en diciembre, Tatiana Schlossberg —hija de Caroline Kennedy y nieta de JFK— falleció a los 35 años. Había revelado públicamente su diagnóstico en noviembre, en un ensayo íntimo y conmovedor publicado en The New Yorker. Allí contó que padecía leucemia mieloide aguda con una mutación rara, un tipo de cáncer que afecta la sangre y la médula ósea y que, en su caso, había sido diagnosticado en mayo de 2024, poco después del nacimiento de su segundo hijo.
Los Kennedy, un clan de poder y de desgracia
La tragedia de la primera generación se remonta a la vida de Rosemary Kennedy, la hija mayor del patriarca Joseph P. Kennedy y de su esposa, Rose. En 1941, Joseph autorizó una lobotomía fallida que dejó a la joven con graves discapacidades de por vida.
Otra tragedia en la misma generación fue la de Joseph P. Kennedy Jr., el hermano mayor destinado a ser el líder político de la familia, quien murió en agosto de 1944 cuando su avión explotó durante una misión secreta de bombardeo en la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Cuatro años más tarde, Joseph y Rose Kennedy perdieron a otra de sus hijas, Kathleen, a sus 28 años, en un accidente aéreo en Francia.
El atentado que acabó con la vida de JFK ocurrió durante su visita oficial a Dallas, en 1963. El 35º presidente de los Estados Unidos tenía 46 años cuando la bala disparada por Lee Harvey Oswald acabó con su vida y redefinió la política moderna estadounidense.
Cinco años más tarde otro disparo mató a su hermano Robert, también conocido como Bob. Ocurrió el 5 de junio de 1968, cuando el candidato demócrata acababa de realizar un triunfal discurso en el hotel Ambassador de Los Ángeles, que lo postulaba como firme candidato a ganar las primarias de su partido en California de cara a las siguientes elecciones presidenciales. Tenía 42 años, y su muerte disipó las esperanzas de otro Kennedy en la Casa Blanca.
En julio de 1969, otro hermano, Ted Kennedy, tuvo un accidente de automóvil en el que murió Marie Jo Kopechne, de 28 años. Según su versión, él intentó salvarla, pero el escándalo de esta muerte, que denunció 10 horas después de haber ocurrido el accidente, le persiguió el resto de su vida y a la larga frustró su propia carrera a la Casa Blanca. Murió a los 77 años de un tumor cerebral.
La de John F. Kennedy Jr. fue la pérdida más mediática, en julio de 1999, cuando el hijo del presidente Kennedy, su esposa, Carolyn Bessette, y su cuñada Lauren murieron al estrellarse el avión que él mismo pilotaba frente a la costa de Martha’s Vineyard.
Los tres viajaban camino de la boda de una prima del que se había convertido en la nueva esperanza de la familia Kennedy para un futuro político, aunque el joven, que tenía entonces 38 años, parecía haber inclinado sus gustos hacia la información y editaba una revista política.

title: México afirma que el narcotráfico no se discute en la negociación comercial con EE.UU.
summary: Ciudad de MéEl secretario de Economía de México, Marcelo Ebrard, aseguró este martes que, a pesar de los constantes señalamientos del presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, respecto al problema del narcotráfico en México, este tema no se discute ni ha afectado, hasta ahora, la mesa de negociación ...
content:
Ciudad de MéEl secretario de Economía de México, Marcelo Ebrard, aseguró este martes que, a pesar de los constantes señalamientos del presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, respecto al problema del narcotráfico en México, este tema no se discute ni ha afectado, hasta ahora, la mesa de negociación del Tratado de Comercio de México, Estados Unidos y Canadá (T-MEC).
Además, el secretario señaló que ese asunto "está en otra mesa, le toca a otras áreas", en declaraciones a periodistas, tras una reunión ante la Junta de Coordinación Política y las comisiones de Economía y de Seguimiento a la Implementación y Revisión del T-MEC del Senado mexicano.
"Más o menos llevamos como unas 115 reuniones, y en las 115 reuniones hasta el día de hoy, me refiero a de Comercio, Tratado 232, nunca me han planteado ese tema (narcotráfico) porque está en otra mesa. Lo que es comercio e inversión es lo que nosotros estamos viendo", dijo Ebrard a medios.
El alto funcionario dijo que eso "es lógico por una razón, porque la relación de México con Estados Unidos es tan larga, tan amplia, que no podrías tener un avance de ninguna especie, ni le conviene a ninguno de los dos países de estar mezclando todos los temas".
"Traemos tema ambiental, tema de agua, tema de migración, no todo es problema, hay unas que sí es problema y otras que no. Es la relación más compleja en el mundo, no creo que haya dos países que tengan tantos temas al mismo tiempo. Entonces, hasta el día de hoy, no (hemos tocado ese tema)", agregó el jefe de cartera.
En este sentido, Ebrard, quien anteriormente fue canciller mexicano, subrayó que el T-MEC tiene una agenda específica en temas de comercio, inversión, energía y condiciones laborales, entre otros.

title: Up to 20% of MS diagnoses may be wrong, like Christina Applegate's
summary: Up to 20% of MS diagnoses are wrong, like Christina Applegate's. Here's what doctors say patients should know. Actor Christina Applegate announced Tuesday that she had been misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis after years of believing she had the condition — and experts say her experience is more co...
content:
Up to 20% of MS diagnoses are wrong, like Christina Applegate's. Here's what doctors say patients should know.
Actor Christina Applegate announced Tuesday that she had been misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis after years of believing she had the condition — and experts say her experience is more common than many people realize.
Applegate shared the news on her podcast, MeSsy, where she and actor Jamie-Lynn Sigler discuss life with MS. In a follow-up episode, Dr. Marwa Kaisey, an associate professor at the Cedars-Sinai Medical Center department of neurology, said that almost 1 in 5 people who are told they have multiple sclerosis "didn't actually have it."
There is no single test to confirm MS, a disease where the body's immune system attacks the central nervous system. Symptoms vary from person to person and it can progress in different ways, according to the National Multiple Sclerosis Society.
How can an MS misdiagnosis be discovered?
CBS News spoke with Dr. Robert Brumel, the director of the Mellon Center for MS at Cleveland Clinic, a multidisciplinary center that cares for more than 11,000 patients with multiple sclerosis, about the risk of an MS misdiagnosis and what patients need to know.
He said a misdiagnosis is most often found when a person seeks out a second opinion because their symptoms aren't getting better. This doesn't always mean the diagnosis is wrong, but can be an indicator for more advanced tests. (Brumel said most MS treatments, especially the ones most commonly used, are "very safe" and wouldn't put a person's health in danger.)
When a misdiagnosis happens, the root cause is typically that abnormalities on brain scans were misinterpreted, Brumel said. Lesions on the brain are considered a hallmark of MS, but they can also be caused by other medical issues such as high blood pressure, smoking or migraines. More advanced MRI sequences can help differentiate between MS lesions and those caused by other conditions, Brumel said.
When concerns about a potential misdiagnosis arise, the next steps typically involve running specialized tests. Those can include advanced MRI sequences to study the lesions more closely, a spinal MRI, or spinal fluid analysis that can identify specific abnormal immune proteins, Brumel said.
How common is an MS misdiagnosis?
On MeSsy, Kaisey described MS misdiagnoses as "fairly common." Brumel said that the largest studies looking at the risk of misdiagnosis have shown that between 15% and 20% of patients diagnosed with MS are found to not actually have the condition.
Dr. Josef Gutman, the director of NYU Langone's Long Island Comprehensive MS Care Center, told CBS News that the wide spectrum of symptoms that can be attributed to multiple sclerosis makes the condition difficult to diagnosis.
"It's important to keep in mind that those symptoms are not necessarily specific in a lot of ways. It's sort of the story, combined with MRI imaging, combined with other markers like spinal fluid, that help us make the MS diagnosis," Gutman said. "It's not like diabetes, where there's one blood test and if it's above this number, it's diabetes, if it's below this number, it isn't. There's a lot of things going into the diagnosis."
New multiple sclerosis diagnostic criteria, developed by an international panel of experts in the field, were published in 2025 to try to reduce this risk. These criteria are more specific than before, according to Brumel, especially when it comes to interpreting brain lesions.
"We really place a high premium on getting the diagnosis correct from the start, so that then we can move very confidently into highly effective therapy for MS," Brumel said.
What happens after an MS misdiagnosis?
If a patient's multiple sclerosis misdiagnosis is identified, doctors will then start looking at other potential causes for their symptoms, Brumel said.
They may be suffering from an autoimmune condition, which can cause joint pain, swelling and system-wide inflammation. Fibromyalgia is a "commonly identified diagnosis that mimics MS," Brumel said. Migraines are also a possible diagnosis, because migraine can cause lesions and other neurological symptoms. Chronic pain or fatigue syndromes can also "masquerade as MS," Brumel said.
Sometimes, a person may not have one disorder but several, Brumel said, noting that an incorrect diagnosis "really sidetracks things."
"MS can sometimes be a gratifying solution to a patient with many symptoms because it's thought of as kind of a single, solitary root cause of things," he said, adding that he has seen patients whose fatigue is caused by a sleep or thyroid disorder, while rheumatoid conditions or fibromyalgia cause pain and swelling.
On her podcast, Applegate said learning she had the wrong diagnosis has made things harder for now, since there's still no explanation for the debilitating symptoms that affect her daily life and mobility.
"You don't get misdiagnosed and then all of the sudden I'm better," Applegate said. "If anything, I've gotten worse. So I'm back at square one where I don't know what's going on with me. And that's going to be an online investigation that my doctors are going to be getting into just to find out what has been going on since 2021, why did this happen?"
When to seek out a second opinion
While only a minority of patients are misdiagnosed, anyone concerned about their diagnosis should always feel comfortable seeking a second opinion, Brumel said. Even when the original diagnosis is correct, a second opinion can help a patient find other resources, he noted.
"MS is a life-changing diagnosis, and anytime somebody is facing something like that, I always think a second opinion is potentially in order," Brumel said.
Patients can also seek out a multiple sclerosis expert, Brumel said. The National Multiple Sclerosis Society maintains an online registry and map of care centers and MS specialists nationwide. Brumel called that list a "really good starting point to identify" nearby resour

title: Ohio race takes ugly turn with ad featuring Amy Acton's mother
summary: Ohio governor's race takes ugly turn with attack ad featuring Amy Acton's estranged mother A new attack ad with unknown origins features the estranged mother of Democratic candidate for Ohio governor Amy Acton calling her a "liar" and defending her GOP opponent Vivek Ramaswamy. Acton's campaign and ...
content:
Ohio governor's race takes ugly turn with attack ad featuring Amy Acton's estranged mother
A new attack ad with unknown origins features the estranged mother of Democratic candidate for Ohio governor Amy Acton calling her a "liar" and defending her GOP opponent Vivek Ramaswamy. Acton's campaign and her brother denounced the ad as a "despicable low."
Acton's mother, Donna Arthur, whose husband was accused of raping Acton when she was a child, says in the spot, "It's not easy for a mother to say this, but Amy was a serious problem. She is a liar; she lies about her past."
Acton's brother, Philip Stearns, lashed out at Ramaswamy in response: "It's not surprising that Vivek Ramaswamy has stooped to such a despicable low as to attempt to turn the sexual abuse Amy endured at twelve years old from our birth mother's husband into a political talking point."
He said that after their stepfather, Cledith Arthur, was arrested and charged, he and Acton were removed from the Arthurs' custody and lived with their father.
"Our birth mother stayed married to Amy's rapist until he died," Stearns said. "This desperate, disgusting attack reveals exactly who Vivek Ramaswamy is at his core – a pathetic excuse for a man who is willing to hurt anyone as long as it gets him what he wants."
The ad, which circulated on social media on Monday night, lacks the mandatory disclosure of who paid for and authorized the commercial. It has not aired on TV or cable but has been widely circulated on social media.
Connie Luck, a spokesperson for Ramaswamy, did not respond to a question about whether his campaign paid for the ad, but said in a statement on Tuesday, "We don't know what happened between Amy and her mother, who first spoke out about Amy in 2020, but we know that Amy Acton is a serial fabulist who has some serious problems with the truth that the public needs to be aware of before deciding who to entrust as governor."
The state Republican Party did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Acton, who served as the state's public health commissioner under GOP Gov. Mike DeWine during the pandemic, has previously talked about being abused by her now-deceased stepfather. According to court records provided by the campaign, in 1978, Arthur was charged with raping Acton, when she was between 10 and 12 years old. He entered a not guilty plea.
Acton has also detailed struggles throughout her early childhood with poverty and homelessness, and records provided by her campaign show that the family lived in a tent for a year.
Acton told the Youngstown Vindicator in 2019 that once she and her brother were able to go live with their father, their lives became more stable.
"In the courthouse after they were charged, I went to give her a kiss, and she just turned her cheek away," Acton told The Vindicator seven years ago. "That was the last time I ever saw her." Her campaign says that court date remains the last time Acton saw her mother.
Her mother and her stepfather, released on bond, left Ohio without facing charges, the news site said. Warrants were issued for Cledith Arthur's arrest at least twice in the next few years, according to court records. Donna and Cledith Arthur lived in Pennsylvania until Cledith's death in 2004.
Ramaswamy's backers have launched other personal attacks against Acton, who has been leading in polls over the last month.
Other aspects of Acton's personal life have also resurfaced during the election, including an incident when police were called to her home in 2019 during what was characterized as a domestic dispute.

title: "Empecé a consumir ketamina a los 14 años y a los 22 necesitaba pañales"
summary: "Empecé a consumir ketamina a los 14 años y a los 22 necesitaba pañales" - Autor, Jenny Rees - Título del autor, Corresponsal de salud de Gales, BBC News - Fecha de publicación - Tiempo de lectura: 8 min Megan Harmes tenía 14 años cuando probó la ketamina por primera vez. Una década más tarde, la re...
content:
"Empecé a consumir ketamina a los 14 años y a los 22 necesitaba pañales"
  - Autor, Jenny Rees
  - Título del autor, Corresponsal de salud de Gales, BBC News
- Fecha de publicación
- Tiempo de lectura: 8 min
Megan Harmes tenía 14 años cuando probó la ketamina por primera vez.
Una década más tarde, la rehabilitación la está ayudando a reconstruir su vida después de que los problemas de vejiga causados por la droga la obligaran a usar pañales para la incontinencia.
La organización benéfica Kaleidoscope, dedicada a la lucha contra las drogas, dice haber experimentado un enorme aumento en las derivaciones a su centro de desintoxicación y rehabilitación en los últimos cinco años: en 2021 solo dos personas habían sido derivadas, frente a las 112 que se han atendido en lo que va de este año.
La mayoría de sus pacientes tiene entre 18 y 24 años.
La Universidad del Sur de Gales está llevando a cabo una investigación sobre las necesidades específicas de este grupo, ya que el daño causado por el "uso crónico y creciente" de la ketamina es mucho más rápido y se produce en un período de tiempo más corto que el causado por el alcohol o drogas como la cocaína, la heroína o el éxtasis.
Los servicios tradicionalmente diseñados para adultos mayores están teniendo que adaptarse para dar soporte a personas mucho más jóvenes, dijo la institución, con necesidades muy diferentes y hábitos que a menudo se generaron en su etapa estudiantil.
Para Megan, una joven galesa de 24 años, el consumo de drogas se hizo más común entre sus compañeros durante el confinamiento por la pandemia de covid-19.
Como estudiante de ingeniería aeronáutica, de repente se encontró trabajando desde casa, cobrando su salario completo y con acceso a una droga cuyo precio se había desplomado.
En los peores momentos, la tomaba "todo el día, todos los días". Megan comentó que le ayudaba a suprimir los síntomas o sentimientos asociados con el trastorno por déficit de atención e hiperactividad y el trastorno límite de la personalidad.
"Ahora que estoy sobria soy muy hiperactiva. No había sido así desde que tenía 14 años; [la droga] me reprimía prácticamente todo", relató.
Finalmente, su consumo de ketamina provocó que perdiera su trabajo, lo que la llevó a una espiral descendente.
Más tarde, Megan encontró trabajo en otro lugar, pero cuatro años de turnos nocturnos afianzaron aún más su adicción, ya que utilizaba ketamina para mantenerse despierta durante la noche incluso en sus días libres.
En los últimos dos años ha estado sufriendo muchísimo, incapaz de mantenerse erguida y necesitando usar pañales para la incontinencia.
"A una joven de 22 años que usa protectores o pañales, eso le quita toda la dignidad", aseguró.
"En aquel entonces, realmente no me importaba si vivía o moría; ahora no quiero morir".
"Llevo poco más de cuatro semanas en rehabilitación y estoy recuperando mi antigua forma de ser", reflexionó.
Megan dijo que no sabrá el alcance de los daños en su vejiga hasta dentro de un tiempo, pero ha subido de peso y físicamente se siente mejor que cuando llegó.
No solo los más jóvenes
Jo Moore dirige el centro de rehabilitación Birchwood de Kaleidoscope. Dice que hace cinco años solo recibieron una solicitud de desintoxicación hospitalaria por ketamina.
"Desde enero de este año hemos visto pasar por aquí a 112 personas", explica, agregando que la mitad de sus pacientes consumían ketamina.
"Es muy, muy barata y muy accesible; eso es lo que permite que la gente la consuma con más frecuencia y en grandes cantidades al mismo tiempo", explica.
Este fármaco se prescribe en centros de salud como anestésico disociativo y también se utiliza en animales, pero en 2014 fue reclasificado como droga de clase B en Reino Unido. Esto significa que es ilegal tomarla, transportarla, fabricarla o venderla.
Se estima que el periodo en 2024-2025, unas 264.000 personas de entre 16 y 59 años consumían ketamina de forma ilícita en Reino Unido; asimismo, el número de personas que buscaron tratamiento por trastornos relacionados con el consumo de ketamina se multiplicó por doce a lo largo de una década.
Si bien los jóvenes han impulsado el aumento del consumo de esta droga, Moore afirmó que el año pasado se observó un incremento en las derivaciones de adultos de entre 25 y 34 años.
En busca de la mejor respuesta
Darren Quelch, investigador de la Universidad del Sur de Gales, dice que las entrevistas con los usuarios del servicio de Birchwood sugieren que el consumo comienza a partir de los 13 años.
Los daños físicos causados por el uso continuado, señala, abarcan desde problemas de memoria y dolor crónico hasta daños en la vejiga e insuficiencia renal.
Los servicios de apoyo están teniendo que adaptarse rápidamente a medida que las necesidades de los usuarios se vuelven más complejas. "[Pero] su especialidad no es lidiar con casos médicos realmente complejos", señala.
"Incluso si lo hicieran, en realidad aún no sabemos cuál es la respuesta correcta", agrega.
Es por ello que Quelch está investigando con Kaleidoscope qué tipos de apoyo son eficaces para este grupo específico de pacientes.
"Esta población es intrínsecamente diferente a muchos otros grupos que podrían recurrir a los servicios de tratamiento de adicciones", apunta.
Otro consumidor de ketamina, Mark, contó que su salud se había deteriorado hasta tal punto que "a los 25 años probablemente tenía el cuerpo de una persona de 80".
"Ya no funcionaba como un ser humano normal".
De niño, en la ciudad inglesa de Liverpool, era un apasionado del fútbol; ahora observa con envidia a otros de su edad que caminan sin dolor.
"Me impidió ser padre para la niña que tengo; dejé de ser el hermano mayor, el hijo responsable", relató.
Mark solía expulsar coágulos con frecuencia y sentía dolor al orinar, pero lo que más ha tenido impacto en él es el colapso de su nariz por inhalar drogas.
"Te destruye por completo la confianza en ti mismo, lo que te lleva a consumir más drogas, porque eso simplemente borra la imagen que tie

title: No Haaland, no problem - can Foden be Man City's alternative goalscorer?
summary: No Haaland, no problem - can Foden be Man City's alternative goalscorer? - Published Phil Foden's magnificent man-of-the-match display in the Champions League against AEK Athens served as a reminder of the prodigious talent that the player still possesses. After two disappointing seasons in which, b...
content:
No Haaland, no problem - can Foden be Man City's alternative goalscorer?
- Published
Phil Foden's magnificent man-of-the-match display in the Champions League against AEK Athens served as a reminder of the prodigious talent that the player still possesses.
After two disappointing seasons in which, by his own admission, he failed to hit the heights expected, there may be those who had forgotten what he can produce.
Being left out of the England squad for the World Cup last summer did not help, but he came into this season telling reporters he was looking forward to a "fresh start" under new manager Enzo Maresca.
Up until last weekend, that fresh start had been a slow burner with the low point of being sent off in the derby against Manchester United in September, before he sparked into life by netting against Ipswich on Saturday.
That was his first Premier League goal in 10 months and a strike that seems to have opened the floodgates, with the 26-year-old netting a superb hat-trick in the 5-1 hammering of Athens at Etihad Stadium on Tuesday.
"I enjoyed that a lot," Foden told TNT Sports. "The lads were great again. We showed determination again. I am a forward so I have to keep scoring and helping the team. It is good for my confidence."
Asked if he was returning to his best form, Foden said: "Slowly, but surely. Still got a long way to go, but I am going in the right direction. Scoring along the way definitely helps.
"I want to keep working hard and keep being the best I can for the manager and the team."
Foden enjoys night in false nine role
A smiling Foden gliding across the turf in full flow is a joy for City fans to watch and he sent them home happy after a performance in which he had a hand in four of the five goals.
Boss Maresca took a risk by making eight changes from the side that beat Ipswich in their last outing, with Gianluigi Donnarumma, Ruben Dias and Foden the players retained.
Striker Erling Haaland was named in the squad but ultimately given the night off after sustaining a blow to the foot in the previous game, giving Maresca the chance to explore his suggestion that Foden could offer a "solution" in the false nine role.
After starting on the right, he moved into that position later in the game and it paid dividends, with Foden saying he "really enjoyed" the role.
Though there was a brief scare for City at the start of the second half when the visitors pulled a goal back to trail 2-1, they found another gear and were out of sight by the final whistle.
And by then, Foden had become just the third Englishman to score a hat-trick and provide an assist in a Champions League match after Wayne Rooney for Manchester United in 2004 and former team-mate Raheem Sterling for City in 2019.
While the first and third goals were converted from close range, the second was a stunning finish from just inside the area, Foden opening up his body and caressing a first-time effort into the top corner.
"Beautiful - that's the word I would use to describe him," former City defender Joleon Lescott said of Foden on TNT Sports. "His finishing was exquisite.
"I think he has convinced the manager that if Erling Haaland isn't available for any reason throughout the season, then he is the man to play at number nine."
'Foden answering manager's questions'
Foden scored 19 goals as City won the Premier League in 2023-24 and was named the Professional Footballers' Association player of the year and the league's player of the season.
He ended last season by failing to score in his last 31 games for club and country but despite the struggles, he signed a new four-year deal in July.
The red card for kicking out at Bruno Fernandes at Old Trafford could have been damaging but the aim now will be kick on and build on this showing.
"I was very happy with Phil, even before the red card to be honest," said Maresca. "I said since day one that I consider him one of the best English players.
"We know that Phil is a top player. Again, for different reasons, he had some problems in the last two years but he is going to help us.
"That is why we are so keen to have him in the best way."
Former England winger Ashley Young said on BBC Radio 5 Live: "When Phil Foden gets his opportunities tonight, he takes them with both hands. By getting a hat-trick, his confidence is going to be sky high.
"Enzo Maresca is going to be happy he hasn't had to bring on Erling Haaland or Jeremy Doku. He has been able to use the players that are in his squad.
"This is no way a second-string but you have got to go our there and show the manager 'I should be playing'.
"Foden is answering his manager's questions."

title: French government extends curfews after riots sweep across the country
summary: French government extends curfews after riots sweep across the country French authorities are extending curfews and increasing the police presence in public spaces as President Emmanuel Macron's government tries to regain control after rioters torched buildings and looted thousands of businesses thi...
content:
French government extends curfews after riots sweep across the country
French authorities are extending curfews and increasing the police presence in public spaces as President Emmanuel Macron's government tries to regain control after rioters torched buildings and looted thousands of businesses this weekend.
But addressing the problems that have brought students and workers to the streets for the last five weeks will be a tougher proposition.
Protesters are demanding better schools and relief from rising living costs, while the government faces mounting debt and a fractured parliament that makes even passing a budget difficult.
More police and curfews
Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu promised a "massive" police deployment Tuesday ahead of the next demonstrations scheduled for Oct. 24. The announcement followed Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez's acknowledgment that authorities had underestimated the unrest and lost control in some cities during Saturday's protests.
More than 2,500 people had been taken into police custody by Monday evening, Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin said, after violence that included the burning of a historic town hall in Limoges, a city in central France.
Overnight curfews have been imposed around Paris' Place de la République and Les Halles shopping district, with restrictions also introduced in Lyon and other cities. Paris and Lyon reported no major incidents Monday night, and authorities are extending the measures.
In an address Sunday, Macron distinguished between the peaceful protests for better schools and working conditions and the rioters who he said hijacked those protests, saying that the government would both listen to the protesters' demands and punish rioters. He blamed "radical far-left groups" and "criminals" for the violence and said that "those who sought to bring down the republic will be held accountable."
Political gridlock and financial pressure
The protests began in mid-September when high school students and teachers in the suburbs of Paris called for changes to overcrowded classrooms, deteriorating buildings and teacher shortages. They have since drawn in trade unions and Yellow Vest activists, a French grassroots organizing group, becoming a broader movement against high living costs and declining public services.
The government has offered some concessions. On Oct. 8, the Ministry of National Education announced plans to deploy more than 3,000 substitute teachers to high schools most in need, and authorized several hundred additional hires.
But worsening financial pressure and political gridlock make more comprehensive changes more difficult. France's public debt stood at nearly 3.6 trillion euros at the end of June, equivalent to 119% of its annual economic output, according to the national statistics agency.
The government expects this year's deficit to reach 5.4% of economic output and is trying to reduce it to 5% in 2027. Interest payments alone are projected to rise by 12 billion euros next year, to 91.2 billion euros, further squeezing the money available for public services.
Macron's allies also lack a majority in the French parliament. This year's budget was adopted only in February, after the government pushed it through without a final vote on the bill, which survived two no-confidence motions.
An Ipsos poll conducted Oct. 7-8 put Macron's approval rating at just 15%. A September Ipsos poll put Marine Le Pen, leader of the far-right National Rally party, well ahead of the field, with 33% to 35% support in different first-round matchups. Former Prime Minister Édouard Philippe and Jean-Luc Mélenchon, leader of the far-left party La France Insoumise, were among those vying for second place.
In April, France will hold presidential elections to choose a successor to Macron, who cannot run for a third term.

title: Caso Axe Ceremonia: Vinculan a proceso a 7 personas y 3 empresas por muertes de Berenice y Miguel
summary: La Fiscalía General de Justicia de la Ciudad de México (FGJCDMX) obtuvo la vinculación a proceso de siete personas y tres empresas por su probable participación en los hechos que provocaron la muerte de los fotoperiodistas Miguel Ángel Rojas Hernández y Berenice Giles durante el festival AXE Ceremon...
content:
La Fiscalía General de Justicia de la Ciudad de México (FGJCDMX) obtuvo la vinculación a proceso de siete personas y tres empresas por su probable participación en los hechos que provocaron la muerte de los fotoperiodistas Miguel Ángel Rojas Hernández y Berenice Giles durante el festival AXE Ceremonia 2025.
La resolución fue dictada por un juez de control durante la madrugada de este martes 20 de octubre, luego de una audiencia que se prolongó durante varias horas. Con esta determinación, el proceso penal avanza tras más de 18 meses de exigencias de justicia por parte de las familias de las víctimas.
De acuerdo con la Fiscalía capitalina, las investigaciones permitieron identificar posibles responsabilidades relacionadas con la administración del Parque Bicentenario, la organización y producción del festival, así como el montaje de las estructuras involucradas en los hechos ocurridos el 5 de abril de 2025.
La resolución también alcanza a una de las empresas por su probable responsabilidad en el homicidio culposo de Berenice Giles, quien murió junto con Miguel Ángel Rojas cuando una estructura colapsó durante el evento musical.
¿Qué empresas fueron vinculadas a proceso por el caso AXE Ceremonia?
De acuerdo con el comunicado difundido por la colectiva ‘Hoy Somos Todo por Miguel’, las tres empresas vinculadas a proceso son:
- La Agencia de los Socios, S.A.P.I. de C.V., perteneciente a Grupo ECO.
- O.N. Producciones Creativas, S.A.P.I. de C.V., también perteneciente a Grupo ECO.
- Operadora Eclectic, S.A. de C.V., encargada de administrar el Parque Bicentenario.
Las personas físicas imputadas desempeñaban funciones de dirección, representación, producción y operación dentro de las compañías relacionadas con el festival.
Las indagatorias de la Fiscalía se centraron en las posibles omisiones en materia de protección civil y en las responsabilidades vinculadas con la instalación de las estructuras que colapsaron y causaron la muerte de los dos fotoperiodistas.
En el caso de Berenice Giles, la empresa administradora del Parque Bicentenario fue vinculada a proceso. Según la información difundida por la Fiscalía, esta compañía no suscribió el acuerdo reparatorio celebrado el 29 de mayo de 2026 entre los familiares de la fotoperiodista, las personas físicas imputadas y las otras dos empresas investigadas.
Caso AXE Ceremonia: Grupo ECO niega responsabilidad ante juez
Tras conocerse la resolución judicial, la colectiva ‘Hoy Somos Todo por Miguel’ celebró la vinculación a proceso, al considerar que representa un avance en la búsqueda de justicia por la muerte de Miguel Ángel Rojas Hernández.
En su comunicado, difundido este 20 de octubre, la organización señaló que, después de más de 18 meses de lucha, un juez determinó que existen datos de prueba suficientes para establecer la probable intervención de las personas y empresas imputadas en los hechos.
Sin embargo, la colectiva cuestionó la postura asumida por las compañías durante el procedimiento penal.
De acuerdo con el pronunciamiento, representantes de las empresas de Grupo ECO habían expresado públicamente su compromiso con las víctimas y asumido responsabilidades por lo ocurrido. No obstante, durante la audiencia judicial, sus defensas sostuvieron que no tenían responsabilidad por la muerte de Miguel Ángel.
La organización también señaló que el defensor de O.N. Producciones Creativas afirmó ante el juez que las empresas de Grupo ECO no eran las organizadoras del festival AXE Ceremonia.
La colectiva consideró que estas posturas contrastan con las declaraciones públicas que las compañías hicieron durante los meses posteriores a la tragedia.
“No podemos aceptar que las empresas asuman públicamente responsabilidades cuando se dirigen a la sociedad, pero pretendan desconocerlas cuando deben responder ante un juez.. ¡LA MUERTE DE MIGUEL ÁNGEL NO FUE COINCIDENCIA, FUE NEGLIGENCIA”, reclamó en su comunicado.

GB men take fourth and must wait for LA28 Olympic spot
- Published
Great Britain narrowly missed out on qualifying for the 2028 Olympic Games at the first attempt as they placed fourth in the men's team final at the Gymnastics World Championships.
Only the top three in Rotterdam were assured of early qualification for the Games in Los Angeles in two years' time, with defending champions Japan taking the gold medal ahead of Russia in second and China in third.
GB's next chance to qualify will be at the World Championships in Chengdu, China in 2027, where a top-nine finish will secure a place in LA.
Courtney Tulloch, Joe Fraser, Jake Jarman, Harry Hepworth and Reuben Ward qualified in second place for the final and finished with a total score of 247.395 on Tuesday.
The team were leading the standings after four of the six rotations, but they just fell short of staying in the medal places as Japan, Russia and China all improved in the closing stages. Japan took the step on the podium with a score of 251.928.
Fraser told BBC Sport the team feel they are in a good position to challenge for titles in the future.
"I think collectively, as a team, we can look at the overall of the team final and know that we are definitely amongst the best in the world, and we can compete with the best in the world," Fraser said.
"We were taking Japan right the way to the end, and up until the parallel bars, we were with them.
"So we know as long as we can work on our routines from the parallel bars and the high bar, we can really contend to be world champions maybe next year."
You can watch coverage of the Gymnastics World Championships, which run until Sunday, 25 October, on BBC Two and BBC iPlayer.

title: Ya está cerrada la ‘puerta negra’ del Banxico: Tasa de interés no tendrá cambios en 2026 ni 2027
summary: El Banco de México no hará movimientos a la tasa de interés en lo que queda de 2026 ni en 2027, esto a pesar de que miembros de la Junta de Gobierno consideran que hay espacio para bajar el referencial, esto según el consenso de la Encuesta Citi publicada este martes 20 de octubre. La mayoría de los...
content:
El Banco de México no hará movimientos a la tasa de interés en lo que queda de 2026 ni en 2027, esto a pesar de que miembros de la Junta de Gobierno consideran que hay espacio para bajar el referencial, esto según el consenso de la Encuesta Citi publicada este martes 20 de octubre.
La mayoría de los analistas, 25 de los 36 consultados, pronostica que la tasa de interés se quedará ‘congelada’ en las reuniones de este y el siguiente año.
De los 11 especialistas que sí ven un cambio en la tasa del Banxico, dos esperan que ocurra este año; ocho pronostican que se materializará en el primer semestre de 2027, y uno más prevé que suceda hasta el segundo semestre.
El pronóstico se da en un contexto en el que el diferencial de tasas entre México y Estados Unidos está en su nivel más bajo de la historia, un factor que disminuyó el atractivo del peso ante los inversionistas y contribuyó a su ‘desplome’ de 6 por ciento en septiembre.
Además, los pronósticos en Estados Unidos apuntan a que la Reserva Federal hará al menos un aumento más a la tasa de interés antes de que termine el año.
¿Qué especialistas ‘apuestan’ por un recorte en la tasa del Banxico?
Bankaool y Finamex prevén que la Junta de Gobierno baje el referencial en su reunión de noviembre.
Para 2027, BNP Paribas, Banco Bancrea, Banorte, Invex, Masari Casa de Bolsa y Natixis contemplan un alza de 25 puntos base a lo largo del primer semestre. Por el contrario, BX+ y Banco Base esperan una rebaja de un cuarto de punto para mayo, y Oxford Economics lo ve para septiembre.
Empeora pronóstico para el tipo de cambio
Los analistas encuestados por Citi esperan que el dólar cierre 2026 vendiéndose en 18.20 pesos, 20 centavos más en comparación con el pronóstico que publicaron hace 15 días.
Al cierre de 2027, el consenso pronostica que el tipo de cambio estará en los 18.60 pesos por dólar, desde los 18.50 de la previsión de hace una quincena, con expectativas que van de 17.00 a 19.80 pesos por dólar.
De acuerdo con la Encuesta Citi, la expectativa del crecimiento del PIB de México para 2026 permaneció en 1.4 por ciento respecto a la encuesta anterior, con un rango de estimaciones que va de 0.9 por ciento a 1.7 por ciento.
En tanto, para 2027 se espera que el alza de la economía de México sea de 1.8 por ciento, igual que en la encuesta anterior, con un rango de estimaciones que va de 1 por ciento a 2.1 por ciento.

summary: Javier Milei y sus medidas, en vivo: el mandatario se refirió al crecimiento energético y habló de una “revancha histórica” El minuto a minuto de las decisiones del Presidente, las reacciones de la oposición y las declaraciones de los funcionarios Autores en vivo (13) En la mesa política admitieron ...
content:
Javier Milei y sus medidas, en vivo: el mandatario se refirió al crecimiento energético y habló de una “revancha histórica”
El minuto a minuto de las decisiones del Presidente, las reacciones de la oposición y las declaraciones de los funcionarios
Autores en vivo (13)
En la mesa política admitieron que el proyecto de ley sobre discapacidad genera divisiones internas
Con asistencia perfecta, el Gobierno reunió este martes a su mesa política para abordar la agenda legislativa que tiene como principal desafío lo que sucederá este miércoles en la Cámara de Diputados, donde se debatirán los proyectos de discapacidad, desendeudamiento e inviolabilidad de la propiedad privada.
El encuentro estuvo encabezado por la secretaria general de Presidencia, Karina Milei, quien por segunda vez en un mes no participó de una comitiva con su hermano, el presidente Javier Milei, de viaje esta vez en España. Se quedó en el país para participar del cónclave de este martes y monitorear de cerca distintos temas legislativos y de gestión.
La chicana de Rodríguez Larreta a Jorge Macri por el furcio sobre Borges: “Ay José”
El exjefe de Gobierno Horacio Rodriguez Larreta chicaneó este martes al alcalde porteño, Jorge Macri, después de que el mandatario local confundiera el nombre del escritor argentino Jorge Luis Borges y lo llamara “José”.
“Ay José Macri”, provocó Rodríguez Larreta, desde sus redes, al hacerse eco del furcio de Jorge Macri, quien lo sucedió en el cargo y con quien, por lo demás, mantiene un fuerte enfrentamiento político.
En Neuquén, el embajador de Estados Unidos ratificó el apoyo a Milei y prometió inversiones millonarias
El embajador de Estados Unidos, Peter Lamelas, ratificó el apoyo del gobierno de Donald Trump a Javier Milei y prometió inversiones millonarias durante un discurso en Neuquén.
El funcionario estadounidense aseguró que habrá US$20.000 millones en inversiones para antes del final de 2027 “para proyectos críticos del futuro de la Argentina”.
La Cancillería brasileña emitió un duro comunicado contra Milei por el ataque a Lula da Silva
Cuando faltan apenas cinco días para el balotaje en Brasil, el Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores del gobierno de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva emitió este martes un duro comunicado contra el presidente Javier Milei, quien más temprano había insultado al líder del PT a través de la red social X. El mandatario libertario lo tildó de “zurdo ladrón” e insinuó que podría manipular los resultados electorales.
“Las ofensas proferidas hoy por el Presidente de la República Argentina contra Brasil, dirigidas esta vez al Poder Judicial y al sistema de voto electrónico, constituyen un nuevo e inaceptable intento de injerencia externa en el proceso democrático brasileño”, reza el comunicado oficial.
El cruce entre dos diputados en la comisión de Presupuesto que casi termina a los golpes
Un tenso intercambio verbal entre Carlos Castagneto (Unión por la Patria) y Andrés Leone (La Libertad Avanza) tuvo lugar este martes durante el debate en la Comisión de Presupuesto y Hacienda de Diputados, que preside Bertie Benegas Lynch.
El episodio ocurrió en medio de la intervención del legislador Esteban Paulón, de Provincias Unidas (PU), cuando el debate llevaba más de tres horas de duración dentro del recinto.
“No hay un solo gasto que esté desfinanciado”: la defensa del Gobierno en el Congreso ante los reclamos de las universidades
“El Ejecutivo está a derecho, como ha estado siempre”, remarcó Alejandro Álvarez, subsecretario de Políticas Universitarias, en la comisión de presupuesto sobre la Ley de Financiamiento Universitario.
Repitió que esa ley, “al modo de ver del Ejecutivo”, incumple la Ley de Administración Financiera y la Ley de Ejecución Presupuestaria, que establecen que, cuando una norma no asigna los fondos adecuados, se promulga y se suspende en el acto.
La Justicia ordenó unificar los juicios de Hotesur y Los Sauces contra Cristina y Máximo Kirchner
La Cámara de Casación resolvió que las causas Hotesur y Los Sauces, que investigan posibles maniobras de lavado a través de las propiedades y habitaciones de hoteles que la familia Kirchner les alquilaba a los empresarios Lázaro Báez, Cristóbal López y Fabián de Sousa, se desarrollen en un único juicio oral.
Así, revirtió la decisión del Tribunal Oral Federal 5, que a mediados de septiembre resolvió desdoblar los procesos. Los fiscales apelaron la medida, advirtiendo que esa decisión podría terminar comprometiendo la prueba recabada y beneficiando a la expresidenta Cristina Kirchner y su hijo, Máximo Kirchner, junto a otros 17 acusados por la maniobra.
Kicillof enfrenta el jueves un nuevo paro docente en la provincia de Buenos Aires
LA PLATA.- El gobernador Axel Kicillof enfrentará un nuevo paro docente el próximo jueves en la provincia de Buenos Aires, después de que la Federación de Educadores Bonaerenses (FEB) rechazara la última propuesta de mejora salarial y llamara a una medida de fuerza de 48 horas.
Las primeras 24 horas de paro tendrán lugar el jueves, en tanto otras 24 horas quedarán con fecha a definir, según informó la FEB tras un congreso extraordinario que tuvo lugar este martes.
Milei llegó a Madrid en plena campaña: lo reciben con críticas del gobierno y sus aliados toman distancia
MADRID.- Javier Milei aterrizó esta tarde en España para realizar su séptimo viaje a este país desde que es presidente. Será una gira corta pero intensa para el libertario en esta capital, que está atravesada por las elecciones que definirán el próximo presidente español el 29 de noviembre. La llegada de Milei fue un sacudón para la campaña electoral, que se empezó a calentar en la previa del viaje y que hasta tendrá esta tarde una manifestación en su contra.
